en: A black‑and‑white view of a landscaped garden with a dramatic war monument in the foreground. The statue shows a standing female figure holding a flag above a fallen soldier with a rifle, all mounted on a large stone pedestal partly covered with foliage. An eagle sculpture is at the base. On the front of the pedestal is an inscription in German script. Behind the monument stands a large neo‑Gothic or historicist brick building with ornate gables, turrets, dormer windows and a prominent rose window, suggesting a town hall or civic building. Tall trees and manicured shrubs frame the scene.
